openIssues.text: No ambient occlusion or contact shadow. Small props read as pasted on when they stand inside a cast shadow. This is half of defect 3 and it needs an AO pass in Tier 1.
Depth of field is not implemented. It needs a DepthTexture, which cannot share the 4x MSAA scene target; add a resolved depth prepass in Tier 1. Do not bolt DOF onto the current target.
Ground detail normal map repeats visibly at its ~22 m tile from the top shot. Needs a second octave at a different repeat, or triplanar variation.
The placeholder heightfield reads as sand dunes: ridged noise plus a bright sandy palette. It is scaffolding, not a look decision, and the world lane replaces it.
Night lighting was tuned to a readable linear median of 0.03 but has had no art pass. Tier 1 owns it.
FRAME_HEIGHT_M = 18 (the deferred orthographic scale) is set from a pixel-height argument, not from playtesting a party of three plus enemies. Revisit once traversal lands.

openIssues.title: Exposure is fixed at 1.05 and only ever tuned at dawn. Every other hour blows out.
openIssues.cause: Not key intensity — KEY_RAMP is nearly flat (6.4 to 7.4 to 6.1). It is cos-law on the ground plus the sky IBL ramp. Ground receives key*sin(elevation): sin(11.6deg)=0.20 vs sin(61.3deg)=0.88, times the sky ramp 3.9 to 4.8. Product ~8.5x, which matches the measured median ratio.
openIssues.fix: postfx.js line ~217 deliberately chose fixed exposure so an art-directed hour cannot drift. Keep that. Make exposure a RAMP over sun elevation in the same idiom as SKY_RAMP and KEY_RAMP, not auto-exposure.

openIssues.title: Dev panel is default-hidden because auto-hide during shots does not work
openIssues.detail: An auto-hide keyed on __DAWN__.shot was tried and failed — the panel update runs before applyShot, so the capture still contains the overlay. Panel is default-off; open with ?dev=1. The UI lane should own a correct fix.
openIssues.repro: set visible default true, then: node tools/shot.mjs --shots hero
